g.text: Nonlinear reaction feedback: saved errors and certified bounds

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #48576b

g.text: Three blocks · 193 saved reference clocks per fixture · dimensionless fixture coordinates
Dots show stored solver samples only. Horizontal segments hold over a whole block; diamonds apply only at block ends.
The native K row is a conditional mathematical control: physical reaction pools, densities and time conversion remain unbound.
